calls.statement:
WITH h AS (SELECT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15),
ex AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15)
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h) holdout_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM h) holdout_distinct,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM ex)) holdout_also_exposed,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM ex) exposed_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=15) exposure_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member)) holdout_not_in_dim,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE join_date > DATE '2025-11-24')) joined_after,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from<=DATE '2025-11-24' AND valid_to>=DATE '2025-11-24' AND marketing_consent)) no_consent_at_start,
 (SELECT mailing_list_size FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025 WHERE campaign_id=15) bak_list,
 (SELECT holdout_size FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025 WHERE campaign_id=15) bak_holdout

calls.statement:
SELECT
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE marketing_consent AND valid_from<=DATE '2025-11-24' AND valid_to>=DATE '2025-11-24') eligible_at_start,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from<=DATE '2025-11-24' AND valid_to>=DATE '2025-11-24' AND marketing_consent) eligible_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15 AND member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE marketing_consent AND valid_from<=DATE '2025-11-24' AND valid_to>=DATE '2025-11-24')) holdout_eligible,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=15 AND e.delivered) delivered_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT campaign_id FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025 GROUP BY 1)) bak_campaigns,
 (SELECT min(campaign_id)||'-'||max(campaign_id) FROM bak_dim_campaign_2025) bak_range,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=15 AND member_id NOT IN (SELECT member_id FROM stg_member_updates)) x
